info.name: Bankko API
info.description:
ITEC 116 final project - Bankko digital banking backend (NestJS, TypeORM, MySQL, JWT).

Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Start the API and run `npm run seed` first; the demo accounts use the password in the demoPassword variable.

Two-step login: with OTP_ENABLED=true (default) a login returns a challengeId; copy the 6-digit code (email, or the server console in development) into the adminCode / customerCode variable and run the matching 'Verify' request to get the token. For the Collection Runner either start the server with OTP_ENABLED=false, or with DEMO_SHOW_CODE=true: the login response then carries demoCode and the tests fill adminCode / customerCode automatically.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Login returns a JWT. Every other endpoint needs it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

exec: if (j.verificationRequired) { pm.collectionVariables.set('adminChallengeId', j.challengeId); if (j.demoCode) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminCode', j.demoCode); pm.test('Code step required, role Admin, email masked', () => { pm.expect(j.challengeId).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Admin'); pm.expect(j.sentTo).to.include('***@'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('accessToken'); }); }

else { pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', j.accessToken); pm.test('Returns a JWT and role Admin', () => { pm.expect(j.accessToken.split('.')).to.have.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Admin'); }); }
pm.test('JWT issued after the code, role Admin', () => { pm.expect(j.accessToken.split('.')).to.have.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Admin'); });

if (j.verificationRequired) { pm.collectionVariables.set('customerChallengeId', j.challengeId); if (j.demoCode) pm.collectionVariables.set('customerCode', j.demoCode); pm.test('Code step required, role Customer, email masked', () => { pm.expect(j.challengeId).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Customer'); pm.expect(j.sentTo).to.include('***@'); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('accessToken'); }); }

else { pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', j.accessToken); pm.test('Returns a JWT and role Customer', () => { pm.expect(j.accessToken.split('.')).to.have.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Customer'); }); }
pm.test('Generic error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid or expired verification code.'));
pm.test('JWT issued after the code, role Customer', () => { pm.expect(j.accessToken.split('.')).to.have.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('Customer'); });
pm.test('Generic error, no hint which field was wrong', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password.'));

item.name: 2. Users
item.description: Register (public), list (admin), read and update (owner or admin).

item.name: 3. Accounts
item.description: Customers open accounts; admins can freeze and reactivate them.

exec: pm.test('Starts at 0.00 and Active', () => { pm.expect(j.balance).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('Active'); });

6. Transactions
item.description: Transfers and bill payments. Every payment needs an Idempotency-Key header.

exec: pm.test('Completed with a reference number', () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('Completed'); pm.expect(j.referenceNumber).to.match(/^BNK-\d{8}-\d{6}$/); });
pm.test('Review fields hidden from the receiver', () => pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property('reviewStatus'));

item.name: 7. Notifications and Audit
item.description: Notifications are created by the system. The audit log is read-only for admins.
